text:
Ibrahim Zaki: quick idea  run regional SI bootcamps (NA/EU/APAC) as a fast-track to cert + marketplace readiness. keep cohorts small (6 SIs), focus on deployment quickstarts, HW validation, and co-marketing play. thoughts? :world_map:
Claire Donovan: love this. suggest 2-day hands-on + 1-day co-marketing prep. day 1 infra + terraform quickstart, day 2 proctored capstone + badge issuance. co-marketing day = joint blog + joint listing checklist.
Maya Singh: operational notes: need vendor rack booking per region, mentor roster per timezone, and listing readiness checklist for AWS/GCP/Marketplace partners. we should also include a short SI-facing SLO doc for latency/cost expectations.
Victor Ruiz: recommend a lightweight partner credit incentive for SIs who finish the fast-track and list on marketplace within 60 days. also require a minimal smoke-test: endpoint up, sample inference <200ms, auth header present.
Ibrahim Zaki: good. plan: week 1 signups + prework; week 2 regional bootcamps; week 4 follow-up marketplace clinic. @marketplace-bot can we reserve sandbox slots for NA/EU/APAC?
marketplace-bot: sandbox allocation request submitted: NA 2024-09-12..2024-09-14, EU 2024-09-19..2024-09-21, APAC 2024-10-03..2024-10-05. please confirm AUPs.
Claire Donovan: prework = reading + a 20-question quiz and a tiny infra exercise. will author quiz and a 1-page quickstart. sample roster CSV we'll ask SIs to fill: 
```
si_name, contact_email, region, preferred_bootcamp_dates, marketplace_interest
Nimbus Systems, ops@nimbus.com, EU, 2024-09-19, AWS
```
Maya Singh: about recordings/privacy  include consent checkbox in signup. default: no recording saved; opt-in stores encrypted link for 30 days. vendor policy may vary per region.
Victor Ruiz: co-marketing: require a one-paragraph case study + logo approval within 30 days for credit. we'll create a marketing intake form.
Ibrahim Zaki: logistics recap: Claire = prework + quiz, Maya = vendor slots + privacy template, Victor = credit policy + marketing intake. target: publish signup form and playbook v0 by Mon 2024-08-26 (1777728000).
Claire Donovan: adding a trainer cheat-sheet for common infra fixes (OOM -> fallback model, 8-bit/16-bit switch; auth 401 -> check key & header). will include escalation steps and a short grading rubric.
Maya Singh: flag: overlap with product launch week 38 for some mentors. suggest backup mentor pool and 30m overlap handoffs.
marketplace-bot: calendar event created: "Regional SI Bootcamp Planning" Tue 10:00 PT. attendees: Ibrahim Zaki, Claire Donovan, Maya Singh, Victor Ruiz. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/si-regional-bootcamp
Ibrahim Zaki: perfect. please drop the signup link in this thread when live. :tada:
